tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bka' bsdu bzhi pa'i bsdus don 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig/yod pa la skur ba mi 'debs shing med pa la sgro mi 'dogs
༄༅/ /bka' bsdu bzhi pa'i bsdus don 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig/yod pa la skur ba mi 'debs shing med pa la sgro mi 'dogs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' bsdu bzhi pa'i bsdus don 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /

oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /yod pa la skur ba mi 'debs shing med pa la sgro mi 'dogs par ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du rtogs nas ston par mdzad pa gang yin thams cad la phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod de skyabs su song nas/ bka' bsdu bzhi pa bstan rtsis chen po rtsa 'grel gyi bsdus don 'grel pa brjod par bya'o/ /de la/ oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ na maḥ zhes pa'i bar gyis spyir bla ma dkon mchog thams cad la mchod par brjod par bstan to/ /de nas/ don dam/ zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mthar thug gi sangs rgyas rang byung ye shes de bzhin nyid la mchod par brjod pa bstan to/ /de nas/ dus bzhi gnyis kyi rab dbye rab bshad bya/ /zhes pas rtsom par dam bca' ba bstan to/ /dus bzhi chen po/ zhes pa nas/ bzang ngan yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis dus bzhi gnyis kyi ngo bo spyir bstan to/ /dang po'i/ zhes pa nas/ so so'i tshad/ /ces pa'i bar gyis dus bzhi gnyis kyi lo grangs bstan to/ /skyon med/ ces pa nas/ chos su gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis dus bzhi chung ba'i ngos 'dzin khyad par du bstan to/ /de dang de yi/ zhes pa nas/ gtsug gis blang*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rdzogs ldan gyi chos gang yin dpang du rung bar bstan to/ /gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ gnod pa bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsum ldan mar bcad kyi gzhung la skyon zhugs pas/ de las bshad pa thams cad bden pa'i nges pa med par bstan to/ /rdzogs ldan chos ni/ zhes pa nas/ nyid du gsungs// zhes pa'i bar gyis rdzogs ldan gyi chos la skyon med pas de la lta sgom spyod pa rnam dag gsungs zhes bstan to/ /gang phyir/ zhes pa nas/ gsungs pa'i phyir/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs rgyas par bstan to/ / bden gnyis ngo bo/ zhes pa nas/ tshul 'di nyid/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bden gnyis ngo bo de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa'i dgos pa bstan to/

/gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ 'khor 'das don du 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis lta ngan can gyi 'dod lugs bstan to/ /snang tshad kun rdzob/ ces pa nas/ nyes skyon gzhan yang dpag med do/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis snang ba gang yin kun rdzob dang*/ stong pa gang yin don dam bden par 'dod pa la ha cang thal ches pa'i skyon bstan to/ /bden gnyis 'khor 'das ngo bo gcig na ni/ /zhes pa nas/ de ltar 'dod na nyes skyon dpag med do/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bden gnyis ngo bo gcig tu 'dod pa dang*/ 'khor 'das ngo bo gcig tu 'dod pa la ha cang thal ches pa'i skyon brjod pa'o/ /rdzogs ldan lugs la nyes skyon de rnams med/ / ces pas rang lugs la skyon med par bstan to/ /shes bya thams cad/ ces pa nas/ lugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis skyon can gyi 'dod lugs brjod pa'o/ /chos nyid dbu ma/ zhes pa nas/ rkang pa lnga 'grel pa dang bcas pas lung rigs kyis sun dbyung ba bstan to/ /thams cad bem rig skyon can/ zhes sogs rkang pa gsum 'grel pa dang bcas pas bem rig gnyis su shes bya thams cad 'dus par rdzogs ldan gyi lung rigs kyis bsgrub par bstan to/ /gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ zhes sogs rnam pa mang pos don dam ni/ shes pa rig pa ye shes yin par ston/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos dbyings shes pa yin pa'i sgrub byed bstan to/ /de phyir skad/ ces sogs rkang pa gsum 'grel pa dang bcas pas chos dbyings ye shes yin yang mi rtag par ma yin gyi mthar thug pa'i de kho na nyid du bstan to/ /gal te don dam rig pa ma yin na/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gal bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos dbyings rig pa yin pa la ha cang thal ba la gnod byed dgod pa'o/ /gal te don dam/ zhes pa nas/ de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po rtag brtan gyi shes pa grub par bstan to/ /gal te don dam shes pa ma yin na/

/zhes sogs kyis rkang pa gsum gyis chos dbyings shes pa min par 'dod pa la gnod byed gnam lcags lta bu bstan to/ /gal te don dam shes pa/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis shes pa yin na mi rtag pa ma yin pa'i rtsod pa bkod nas/ de 'dra/ zhes sogs nas/ myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis shes pa gang yin mi rtag par 'dod pa lta ngan yin pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyi shes pa rdzogs ldan las gsungs pa'i khungs ma chod pa dang gsung rab kyi gnad zab cing phul du byung ba rnams kyang khungs ma chod par bstan to/ /rdzogs ldan/ zhes pa nas/ gsungs pas gnod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis dkyil 'khor dang lha dang sngags dang rgyud dang rigs dang dkon mchog gang yin thams cad sngar med phyis byung ba'i 'dus byas su 'dod pa la lung rigs kyis gnod byed bstan to/ /gsungs pa de rnams/ zhes pa nas/ gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyis mthar thug gi sangs rgyas la sogs rtag brtan yin pa drang don du 'dod pa la sgrub byed med cing gnod byed yod par bstan to/ /gal te/ zhes pa nas/ shin tu mang bar yod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis thams cad kun rdzob tu yod kyi don dam par cir yang ma grub par 'dod pa la/ khyab byed khegs na khyab bya khegs pa la sogs pas don dam med na kun rdzob kyang med par ha cang thal pa'i skyon gyis gnod pa bstan to/ / de phyir 'gro ba/ zhes sogs/ rkang pa gnyis kyis sems can thams cad la chos zab khyad 'phags kyi byin rlabs 'jug par smon pa'o/ /shes bya la ni/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis spyir shes bya tsam gyi rnam dbye dang*/ khyad par du shes pa dang ye shes kyi rnam dbye la sogs pa rdzogs ldan gyi chos lugs khyad 'phags rnams bstan to/ /rdzogs ldan chos/ zhes pa nas/ dgongs pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos dbyings sher phyin zab mor gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/

/gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ bslad pa'i lugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis lta ngan can gyi 'dod lugs brjod de lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo bar bstan to/ /rdzogs ldan la ni/ zhes pa nas/ lugs la yod// ces pa'i bar gyis rdzogs ldan lugs kyi rnam gzhag legs po bstan to/ / gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ bdo bar byas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis skyon can gyi 'dod pa bstan to/ /bde gshegs snying po/ zhes pa nas/ sngar sangs rgyas kyang yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis kun gzhi ye shes de mdo sngags thams cad kyi nges don mthar thug yin par bstan to/ /gsum ldan/ zhes pa nas/ bdo bar byas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis de ltar ma gtogs pa'i skyon bstan to/ /rdzogs ldan chos/ zhes pa nas/ de dag gcig tu bsre bar ma gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyis kun gzhi rnam shes 'di rgyu'i rgyud dang rang bzhin 'od gsal la sogs ma yin gyi/ kun gzhi ye shes ni rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal la sogs yin pas kun gzhi gnyis po legs par byed dgos par bstan to/ /gal te bsres na/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis de gnyis gcig tu bsres pa'i nyes dmigs chen po dpag tu med pa bstan to/ /rdzogs ldan/ zhes pa nas/ nam mkha' 'dra// zhes pa'i bar gyis sbyang gzhi la sogs chos gzhi dpe dang bcas te bstan to/ / de ltar gsungs kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ mang bar mchis/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sbyang bya dang sbyang gzhi gcig yin na ha cang thal ches pa'i skyon bstan to/ /yongs grub/ ces pa nas/ lugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'gyur med yongs grub dang dbu ma chen po gcig nyid du bstan to/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can/ zhes pa nas/ lugs las 'byung*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rang bzhin gsum sems tsam pa kho na'i chos skad yin par 'dod pa la sgrub byed med cing gnod byed yod par bstan to/ /de phyir de 'dra'i/ zhes pa nas/ ri bong rwa dang mtshungs/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis grub mtha'i rnam gzhag tshul bzhin ma shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ngo bo nyid gsum ston tshad sems tsam yin zhes pa dang*/ de ston pa'i gang zag thams cad sems tsam pa yin zhes pa dang*/ don dam par cir yang grub pa med pas dbu ma yang cir yang ma grub ces pa dang*/ de ltar ston tshad dbu ma pa chen po yin zhes thams cad lta ngan du bstan to/ /gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ mi 'gal lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rten med na brten pa med pa la sogs pas don dam med na kun rdzob kyang med par ha cang thal ches pa bstan to/ /dbu ma la ni rang rgyud/ ces pa nas/ mkhas pa chen por 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thal 'gyur dang rang rgyud gnyi ga dbu ma'i dbye bar 'dod pa bkag nas/ de bzhin nyid sogs don dam gyi lha sngags thams cad dbu ma'i dbye ba yin par lung rigs kyis bsgrub par bstan to/ /rang rgyud thal 'gyur/ zhes pa nas/ yin mod kyang*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thal 'gyur dang rang rgyud gnyi ga yod pa'i phyogs su lhung bas dbu ma las phye ba'i ya gyal yin par mi rigs pa dpe don dang bcas te bstan to/ /gsum ldan/ zhes pa nas/ lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gzhan gyi 'dod lugs nor ba brjod pa'o/ /de ltar yin na/ zhes pa nas/ gsungs phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis de ltar 'dod pa de sdig lta chen po yin par rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa bstan to/ /mdo rgyud zab mo/ zhes pa nas/ gzhi la dgongs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis stong nyid zab mo mthar thug de mtha' thams cad kyis stong pa'i gzhi yin gyis mtha' dang bral tsam gyi rang stong med dgag ni ma yin par bstan to/ /stong gzhi/ zhes pa nas/ rnam dag rgyud sde rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis stong gzhi chos dbyings zab mo de kun rdzob kyi chos 'di thams cad gtan nas ma yin gyi gnas lugs bde ba chen po'i ye shes gzhan stong zab mo don dam pa'i lha rgyud la sogs zab mo mthar thug thams cad yin pas de ltar ston pa'i bka' bstan chos thams cad kyang dbu ma chen po'i gzhung du bstan to/

/gsum ldan/ zhes pa nas/ 'gal bar 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis rten 'brel dbu mar 'dod pa dang*/ dbu ma rten 'brel du 'dod pa la'ang 'dus byas thams cad dbu mar ha cang thal ches pa'i skyon brjod pa'o/ /de phyir rten 'brel/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis rten 'brel la'ang bden gnyis rnam dbye shes dgos par bstan to/ /kun rdzob/ ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel rtogs pa ni dbu ma'i lam yin gyi rten 'brel de dbu ma la sogs gshis lugs zab mo mthar thug thams cad min par bstan to/ /don dam rten 'brel/ zhes sogs nas/ spyod yul min/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis don dam rten 'brel de kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang*/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi las rlung rnams gdod nas 'gags pa'i gzhi bden don bcu gnyis la sogs yin par mdo rgyud kun las gsungs par bstan to/ /de rnams/ zhes pa nas/ ga la rung*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis kun rdzob thams cad kyis gdod nas stong zhing dben la dag pa'i gzhi don dam de bzhin nyid 'gyur med yongs grub de sems tsam las shin tu 'das pas/ de ltar ston zhing 'dod pa rnams kyang sems tsam pa las shin tu 'das par bstan to/ /chos 'khor gnyis pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ zab mo mthar thug thams cad yin phyir ro/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo'ang gzhan stong zab mo de bzhin nyid yin zhing*/ de yang rang stong chad stong bem stong med dgag yongs gcod du ci yang ma grub tsam pa de 'dra gtan nas ma yin gyi/ yon tan dpag yas tshang ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid don dam pa'i e waṃ ye shes sku rang bzhin 'od gsal yum chen mo rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang sher phyin zab mo la sogs pa zab mo mthar thug thams cad yin par bstan to/ /de phyir rgyal yum/ zhes pa nas/ stong nyid 'di min stong nyid gzhan mchog yin/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis bka' 'khor lo tha ma gnyis dang rgyud sde bzhi'i brjod bya'i gtso bo stong nyid zab mo der gcig cing*/ de yang rnam shes dang rang stong la sogs kun rdzob kyi chos gang yang yin mi srid kyi rang byung ye shes don dam pa'i tshad ma phung po khams sogs bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad pa cha med kun 'gro 'gyur med yongs grub la sogs zab mo mthar thug thams cad yin par bstan to/ /byang chub phyogs/ zhes pa nas/ 'gog bden te/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis byang chub phyogs chos nas ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi bar la yang bden gnyis rnam dbye byas nas don dam gyi byang chub phyogs la sogs pa thams cad kun rdzob gtan nas min gyi 'gog bden zab mo yin par bstan to/ /rgyu rkyen med cing*/ zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis chos dbyings dang nam mkha' dpe can dang*/ dper gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /rang gis mi stong*/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis chos dbyings stong nyid yin pa'i stong tshul gyis dpe don gyi dgongs pa bstan to/ /rtog la mi snang*/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis la lar mi snang bar dang*/ la lar snang bar dpe don sbyar te gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bstan to// rang bzhin bde/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis chos dbyings bde ba chen por dpe don sbyar te gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /bden gnyis rgya mnyam/ zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis dar yug chen po'i dpes mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /kun tu khyab cing*/ zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis ling tog la sogs pa'i skyon gyis mig gis mi mthong ba dang*/ khron pa rko ba la sogs pas mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /gzugs/ zhes sogs rkang pa lngas chos dbyings dpe las 'das par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /kun la yod kyang*/ zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bum nang mar me dang dbul po'i gter chen la sogs pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/

/dri ma sangs na/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis chu khams gser dang nam mkha' la sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /dri ma zad/ ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis nam mkha' mi zad pa la sogs pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ / mthar thug /ces sogs rkang pa bzhis sprin yod med kyi nam mkha' yang nam mkhar gcig pas mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /nges don mthar thug /ces sogs rkang pa bzhis sprin yod kyi nam mkha' sprin sangs su gyur pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i dgongs pa bstan to/ /ji bzhin rdzogs par/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis dpe med pa dang dpe dang bcas par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bsdus te bstan to/ /rgyu mtshan yang dag /ces pa nas/ rnam gzhag nyams/ /zhes sogs kyi bar gyis gshis lugs 'khrul lugs spang gnyen la sogs ma 'dres par gsung rab rnam dag rnams nas bstan kyang gsum ldan mar bcad blo skyon can rnams kyis rang gi blo skyon don la sbyar nas lta sgom rnam dag nyams par byas zhes bstan to/ /gshis lugs ji bzhin/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis lta sgom rnam dag bstan to/ /phal cher/ zhes pa nas/ de dag kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis nges don zab mo'i lta sgom med cing gtso bor mi skyong yang tshul khrims srung ba la sogs pa spyod pa rnam dag mnga' ba'i cha de la rjes su yi rang zhing lta sgom spyod pa thams cad phyin ci ma log par mdzad pa thams cad la yang dad cing gus pas rjes su yi rang bar bstan to/ /gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ legs pa'i skad 'dir gtong*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis lta sgom log par zhugs pa rnams la byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslang ste/ lta sgom log pa de dag spongs shig ces ma phod pa'i gros 'debs pa bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa/ zhes pa nas/ dgongs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'gyur med yongs grub dgu dang bcu gnyis la sogs pa rtag tu de bzhin nyid du gnas pa nges don du gsungs pas don dam cang med du ma smra shig ces bstan to/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog /ces pa nas/ bstan du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis khyad par du nyon mongs 'di nyid mthar thug gi ye shes su ston pa'i lung rig rnam dag med pas/ nyon mongs rnam rtog 'di ye shes su 'dod pa'i lta log spang bar gdams pa bstan to/ /thams cad gzhi med/ ces pa nas/ dgongs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos thams cad kyi gnas dang rten dang gzhi chos dbyings su nges don gyi lung rnam dag las gsungs pas thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du ma smra shig ces bstan to/ /shes bya thams cad/ ces pa nas/ gsungs pa'i gzhung mchog rnams kyang gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis don dam mthar thug gang yin thams cad dngos po dngos med gang yang ma yin pa'i phung gsum yin pas shes bya thams cad dngos po dngos med du kha tshon ma chod par bstan to/ /bden pa yang dag /ces pa nas/ gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos can thams cad mi bden yang chos nyid de bzhin nyid bden pa'i mchog tu nges don gyi gsung rab du ma las gsungs pas bden pa yod med du ma smra shig ces bstan to/

/rtag par rtogs/ zhes pa nas/ gros 'debs te/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis rtag chad kyi lta ba ma yin pa la rtag chad kyi lta bar 'dod pa rnams la phan sems kyis bslangs nas de skad ma smra shig ces bstan to/ /rtag par rtogs la skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /zhes pa nas/ gzigs su gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis rtag pa la sogs la rtag pa la sogs su rtogs pa la skyon med la/ don la chad pa la sogs la don la chad pa la sogs su rtogs pa la'ang skyon med kyi de dang de la sogs pa las bzlog ste rtogs pa la skyon yod do zhes bstan to/ /gshis la/ zhes pa nas/ gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis don dam par sangs rgyas grub ste dang po'i sangs rgyas grub pa'i phyir/ de bas na don dam par sangs rgyas med par ma smra shig ces bstan to/ /gshis la ye shes/ zhes pa nas/ gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis skad cig dang bral pa'i ye shes rtag brtan nges don gyi gsung rab du ma las gsungs pas don la ye shes med par ma smra shig ces bstan to/ /bde gshegs/ zhes pa nas/ ha cang thal bas gnod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bde gshegs snying po drang don yin pa la ha cang thal ches pa'i skyon bstan to/ /bde gshegs snying po drang don/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bde gshegs snying po drang don yin pa'i sgrub byed rnam dag med ces bstan to/ /nges don/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis de nges don yin par lung rigs rnam dag gis grub pas nges don yin pa la gnod byed med par bstan to/ /gal te la la'i/ zhes pa nas/ yon tan bgrang yas gsungs pas gzigs su gsol/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bde gshegs snying po yon tan dpag med can du nges don gyi gsung rab las gsungs pas bde gshegs snying po nges don yin yang de'i yon tan drang don yin zhes pa la sgrub byed med la gnod byed yod pa'i sgo nas dgag pa bstan to/

/gal te sangs rgyas rtag /ces pa nas/ srid pa la ni lung rigs dpag yas mchis/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sangs rgyas rtag pa mi srid na 'dus ma byas kyi sangs rgyas kyang med par mtshungs shing kun rdzob kyi sangs rgyas yod pa'i phyir don dam pa'i sangs rgyas kyang yod la/ don dam gyi sangs rgyas med par ston pa'i lung rigs rnam dag med ces bstan to/ /rang ngo shes pas/ zhes pa nas/ spong gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyis tshogs gnyis ma bsags kyang rang ngo shes pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas thob ces 'dod pa la/ shes pa thams cad kyis rang ngo shes pa'i phyir sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob zin par 'gyur zhes pa'i gnod byed bstan to/ /gal te rang ngo*/ zhes pa nas/ blun po rang bzo mkhan gyi spyod yul min/ /ces pa'i bar gyis rang sems rnam shes 'di chos skur rtogs pas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa la snang ba thams cad mun par thal ba la sogs ha cang thal ches pa'i skyon du ma bstan to/ /gal te rang sems/ zhes pa nas/ rnam pa kun tu 'bral bar ma gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyis chos sku dang stong pa nyid tha dad gtan med kyi gcig ma yin te/ stong nyid yin la chos sku ma yin pa mtha' yas yod pa'i phyir/ zhes chos nyid stong nyid kyi rnam dbye legs par bstan to/ / gsum ldan mar bcad/ ces pa nas/ zhu ba 'bul/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thams cad rang stong yin pas rten gsum bzhengs pa la sogs dge ba rjes can ma byed par tshogs 'khor la sogs dge ba rjes med kyis zer ba'i 'dod pa brjod de phan sems kyis de skad ma smra shig ces gros 'debs pa bstan to/ / don dam sangs rgyas/ zhes pa nas/ mang du 'byed gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyis bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dkon mchog thams cad la byin rlabs nus mthu dpag yas mnga' bas de'i rten gsum bzhengs pa la bsod nams dpag med 'byung bar lung rigs kyis grub par bstan to/

/rgyal ba skyon med/ ces pa nas/ sdig chen yin par gsungs pa ma mthong ngo*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi rten gsum bzhengs pas bsod nams chen po thob cing ched du gtad nas bshig na sdig chen du 'gyur gyi rang zhig tu song ba la sdig pa med pas/ bsod nams 'dod pas rten gsum bzhengs shig ces gdams pa'o/ /bdag ni skye ba thams cad/ zhes sogs kyis tshe rabs thams cad du bstan pa rin po che la bya ba byed nus pa'i smon pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid gsum/ zhes sogs kyis gsung rab kyi gnad zab mo ma rtogs pa'i gzhan gyi 'dod lugs log bshad rnams spang bar gdams te spong bar smon pa'o/ /'grel par/ mig mangs rgya dang ma 'brel na/ /zhes sogs kyis yin lugs 'di yin med pa'i 'dod lugs mang po smos te slob ma la bstan cing bris pa la snying po ci yang med ces gtso bor bstan nas zhar la gshis lugs dang ma 'brel ba'i 'khrul lugs thams cad la snying po med pas spang dgos par bstan to/ /de ltar legs par rnam par/ zhes sogs kyis de ltar lta sgom spyod pa skyon can rnams spangs nas skyon med nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung bsgrub pa yin zhing des rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa'i 'jig rten chos brgyad la sogs rnam g.yeng thams cad spong la thar pa sgrubs shig ces bstan to/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas kyi/ zhes sogs kyis 'dis rdzogs ldan gyi gzhung dpang du byas te chos ma dag pa sun phyung nas/ dam pa'i chos rnam dag bstan pa'i phyir/ bka' bsdu ba yin la/ spyir bka' bsdu bar 'dod pas kyang*/ rdzogs ldan gyi gzhung dang*/ khyad par du rgyal ba'i rang 'grel sogs dpang du gyis la/ bstan pa gsal bar mdzod cig /ces gdams pa'o// //bka' bsdu bzhi pa bstan rtsis chen po'i bsdus don 'grel pa rton pa bzhi ldan gyis bkod pa'o// //maṅga laṃ/
